text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on by her friends, Tosen Jordan 
shone brilliantly in 1st place on the 
stage of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupted in awe. The raucous 
cheers and applause showed no sign of 
quieting down at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan smiles at her Trainer, 
asking, "Wasn't I the absolute best idiot 
ever?"
